seoTitle: Movie Title Generator: Film Name Ideas by Genre

nameSource.note: Titles are built from word lists and the patterns each kind of film uses: Operation codenames for action, "Falling for the…" for romcoms, B-movie "Attack of the…" creatures and Christmas films set somewhere snowy. Every result is checked against a list of famous film titles, and franchise names are left out.
